address: 14B Lo Su Street, Ly Thai To Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, 11007, Vietnam
bio: An 18-seat kitchen counter is the focal point of this snug buzzy wine bar. Shelves of empty wine bottles adorn the walls, and the wine list showcases over 350 vintages from the Old World. They offer a vast array of wines by the glass and from a Coravin. The neatly presented, modern dishes are Mediterranean at heart with an Asian twist and deliver accurate, well-judged flavours. Don't miss the homemade pasta: the pride and joy of Etēsia....
